claim: The two camera bodies are distinguished by serial number rather than by label: A23H723003 is the blue arm and A24M723015 is the red arm.
validity_conditions: Ruled TRANSFER under 10.2.1 and passed 10.3 rule 1, so it caps at E3 -- a run taken in another project is not a run taken here. 10.2's hardware-control-path row is open and says in its own rule that it does not wait for envelope/, because wrapping a control path needs no safety limit. Slot: O1 preflight, which has to know which body it opened. The labels are the thing not to trust: this store already records that the two bodies are the same model, so nothing about a frame distinguishes them, and it already records one instance of this instrument's paper record diverging from its hardware. A serial is addressable, so either number now finds this entry.
